name: redmine-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Redmine

scripts.redmine:seed:config: docker compose -f docker/compose.yml exec -T redmine bin/rails runner /seed/config.rb
scripts.redmine:seed:data: docker compose -f docker/compose.yml exec -T redmine bin/rails runner /seed/data.rb
scripts.redmine:seed: npm run redmine:seed:config && npm run redmine:seed:data
